maya: Heads-up: followups are drifting again. I sketched a compact 'closure gates' runbook to tighten ownership and make recurring signals actionable. dropping the short draft.

henry: paste the gates pls

maya: short runbook: 

```
Gate 0 (T+0): incident declared, tags assigned, rough fingerprint
Gate 1 (T+24h): owner assigned (primary + backup) + rollback decision owner noted
Gate 2 (T+72h): remediation scope doc + test plan (PR/CI links), set a target ETA
Gate 3 (T+7d): checkpoint update (status: green/yellow/red), blockers, next steps
Gate 4 (T+21d): QA/regression signoff + ops playbook edits
Gate 5 (T+45d): closure review: metrics check, lessons logged, followups scheduled if needed
Recurring rule: if same fingerprint occurs twice within 60d => escalate to SRE lead and open a "pattern review" slot.
```

jen: add automated reminders at Gate1/3/5 and a CSV export for execs.

tara: for IC rotation 1 propose weekly ICs with named backups. new IC covers followups for first 48h post-incident so ownership doesn't flip mid-remediation.

owen: agree. also suggest a tiny "handoff checklist" the outgoing IC runs before end-of-shift: create followup scaffolds, assign backups, and confirm Gate2 doc exists.

maya: pilot proposal: 5-week pilot with the next oncall cohort. metrics: %assigned<24h, median time-to-gate2, overdue% at 21d, repeat-fingerprint rate. I'll run the pilot and post weekly summaries.

henry: I'll add dashboard tile for open actions and overdue counts. will include CSV export and an API endpoint for the Console.

incident-bot: scheduling pilot kickoff: Mon 2024-12-16 10:00 PST. Will DM Gate reminders at T+24h, T+7d, and T+45d.

tara: I'll update the runbook with the gates and handoff checklist and post in #eng-oncall.

maya: thanks all 1 dropping the short template in the channel and will send the invite. :thumbsup:
